description: Renders LaTeX documents, mathematical formulas and TikZ drawings.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-latex><script type="tp/latex">\section{A first document}
The area of a circle is $A=\pi r^2$.</script></tp-latex>

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a LaTeX document; takes precedence over value and inline source.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: LaTeX source; takes precedence over inline source when present.

events.name: tp-latex-error
events.description: Emitted when loading or conversion fails.

events.name: tp-latex-rendered
events.description: Emitted after document conversion. Nested formulas and figures may still be rendering.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-math
dependencies.summary: renders LaTeX or AsciiMath expressions as inline or display-style SVG.

dependencies.name: tp-tikz
dependencies.summary: Compiles TikZ drawings into SVG with Unicode text, colors and directional fading.

credits.name: tp-latex
credits.summary: LaTeX.js conversion and patched TikZJax assets.

credits.name: tp-latex
credits.summary: LaTeX.js conversion and patched TikZJax assets.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-latex>` element renders LaTeX documents, mathematical formulas and TikZ drawings.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Links and embedded components | Follow document links and use each embedded component’s controls. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component. <kbd>Shift</kbd> may be needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component in the hierarchy and open its help. |
